name: ai-badge
summary: A small outline pill with the AI sparkle that marks content an AI made or suggested — "AI draft", "Suggested".
useWhen: A card, field, list row or message holds content the AI wrote or proposed, and people should know before they rely on it.

alternatives.name: tone-badge
alternatives.when: the label is a status, tier or category rather than "made by AI".

alternatives.name: ai-mark
alternatives.when: there is no room for words and the mark alone is enough.

rules.do: Use the AI badge to say who made the content: "AI draft", "Suggested", "Generated".
rules.dont: Use it as a status ("Active", "New") — status belongs to ToneBadge.

a11y: Renders through Badge as a non-interactive span; the words carry the meaning and the mark is decorative.
